stage_name_zh: 阶段 4：顶会论文、具身智能/生成建模、学术演讲与全周期综合复习（Day 76–116）
learning_objectives_zh: 全周期巩固第 107 天预定间隔复习词群，强化多义辨析与跨场景（AI/时序/具身智能论文、演讲、六级/雅思托福）主动写作。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G035】机器学习、时间序列、生成模型与具身智能（Embodied AI）的技术表达句法；【G004】冠词系统（a/an, the, 零冠词）与学术特指/泛指边界。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP011】多方法跨维度对比（In Terms Of / With Respect To / Whereas），彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 机器学习、时间序列、生成模型与具身智能（Embodied AI）的技术表达句法
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 面向深度学习、时间序列预测、生成式建模与具身智能（Embodied AI）写作，训练如何用精准、克制、零 AI 腔的英语句式描述数学符号、分布特性、物理/几何约束、感知—动作闭环（perception-action loop）及实验消融。
rules: 问题与符号定义：用 Let X denote... / Here, N denotes... / We parameterize the predictive distribution as... 保持全篇符号（notation）一致，严格区分标量（scalar）、向量（vector）与矩阵（matrix）。
时间序列与生成模型：严格区分平稳性（stationarity）与遍历性（ergodicity）、季节性（seasonality，固定日历周期）与周期波动（cyclicality，非固定时长）、概率校准（calibration，预测分布与观测频率一致）与锐度（sharpness，预测分布集中度）。

具身智能（Embodied AI）：准确使用 spatial orientation（空间方位）、trajectory（运动/策略轨迹）、velocity（速度矢量，含方向）、perturbation（外部扰动）、closed-loop feedback（闭环反馈）及 physical/kinematic constraints（物理与运动学约束），不把仿真结果（simulation）直接冒充真实物理部署（real-world deployment）。
examples: Time Series & Generative: Forecast calibration concerns statistical consistency between predictive distributions and observations, whereas sharpness refers to the concentration of the predictive distribution.
Embodied AI: The controller enforces velocity and torque constraints while tracking the reference trajectory under external perturbations.
Ablation & Baseline: Removing the seasonal decomposition module degrades performance on long-horizon benchmarks, confirming its contribution to stability.
common_errors: 把仿真环境（simulation）中的策略表现直接写成真实世界因果有效，忽略 sim-to-real discrepancy。
混淆 covariance（协方差，受量纲缩放影响）与 correlation（标准化相关系数），或混淆 isotonic（保序的）与 isotropic（各向同性的）。

grammar_instruction.name: 冠词系统（a/an, the, 零冠词）与学术特指/泛指边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 冠词决定名词短语的指称范围：单数可数泛指用 a/an；指代本研究特定样本/模型（the sample, the model）或带 of 后置限定的属性（the accuracy of the measurements, the nature of the task）用 the；复数可数或不可数表普遍概念用零冠词。
rules: 单数可数名词在句中不可裸奔（bare singular），必须带冠词或限定词（a limitation, the protocol, each trajectory）。
注意冠词改变词义：nature（零冠词）指“大自然”，而 the nature of the problem 指“问题的基本性质”；in charge of（主动负责） vs in the charge of（由他人看管负责）。
图表编号直接作专名指称时不加 the（see Table 1, Figure 2 shows），但普通名词需加冠词（in the table below）。
examples: Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.
The nature of the task determines which measures are appropriate.
As can be seen in Table 1, the groups differ in size.
common_errors: 单数可数名词漏掉冠词：*We conducted survey / *Trained model achieved lower error。
图表编号前误加冠词：*See the Table 2（应为 See Table 2）。

grammar_instruction.name: 不定式与动名词的补足语分工及非谓语动词搭配
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 动词后接不定式（to do）还是动名词（doing）取决于动词配价规约；同时注意 warrant, facilitate, advocate, involve, consider, anticipate 等核心学术动词的补足语限制。
rules: 接动名词（doing）或名词、不接不定式的典型动词：consider, involve, advocate, anticipate, recommend, suggest, warrant（warrant further investigation / warrant revising），facilitate（facilitate comparison，严禁写 *facilitate sb to do）。
接不定式（to do）的典型动词：aim, attempt, tend, seek, intend, resolve, enable sb to do, allow sb to do, force sb to do, oblige sb to do。
examples: The report advocates providing clearer information to applicants.
The procedure involves checking every record twice.
A common reporting format can facilitate comparison across studies.
common_errors: 误用不定式：*warrant to conclude / *facilitate researchers to compare / *advocate to provide / *involve to check。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 多方法跨维度对比（In Terms Of / With Respect To / Whereas）
expression_pattern_instruction.template: The methods are compared in terms of [Metric A] and [Metric B]: [Method 1] excels in [Condition 1], whereas [Method 2] is more robust to [Condition 2].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 有据、具体地对比不同模型或方案的优劣，拒绝一刀切吹嘘。
examples: The methods are compared in terms of accuracy and computational cost.
The first model uses monthly data, whereas the second uses daily data.
common_errors: 比较主语悬垂或未指明比较维度。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 使用 respectively 与平行结构实现高密度信息配对
expression_pattern_instruction.template: [Symbol/Group A] and [Symbol/Group B] denote/represent [Entity X] and [Entity Y], respectively.
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在不增加从句负担的前提下清晰交代多组符号或实验参数的一一对应关系。
examples: The symbols x and y denote temperature and demand, respectively.
The slope and intercept of f(x) = ax + b are a and b, respectively.
common_errors: 前后序列元素数量不匹配或顺序颠倒。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：严格线性映射保持原点，仿射映射可有平移项；affine 不能泛指所有非线性变换。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The affine function f(x) = ax + b includes an intercept b.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 理论推导高频词：固定接介词 to（be amenable to analytical treatment），意为“可用解析方法求解/处理”。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The simplified model is amenable to analytical treatment.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：对应名词 anomaly；异常不必然是假值或误差，应依据预先说明的规则处理。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An anomalous observation should be investigated before it is removed.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：可数名词，复数 anomalies；异常可能来自真实事件、测量误差或模型局限，不能直接判为错误。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: An anomaly in the sensor readings prompted a check of the calibration procedure.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：专业医学词；药物类别名不能证明某药对某人有效；写作中 medication/agent 比将形容词孤立作名词更清楚。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The study records the use of antidiabetic medication at baseline.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：可指具代表性的原型，不等于每个实例都具有全部性质；archetype 是名词，技术说明需给出具体过程假设。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A random walk with independent identically distributed increments of positive finite variance is an archetypal example of a nonstationary process.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：表达可争论但有理由的判断，仍需说明理由和条件；并非给无证据的绝对判断加一个词就足够。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A distributional forecast is arguably more informative when decisions depend on tail risk.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：本例指标准化的 Pearson 自相关，要求相应方差有限且非零；恒定序列的归一化自相关因分母为零而未定义；若只写成滞后的函数，需要相应平稳条件；自相关不等于因果作用。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: When the relevant variances are finite and nonzero, lag-one Pearson autocorrelation measures the linear association between observations one time step apart.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：含义依学科而定；canonical form 必须对应具体数学约定，canonical example 指具有代表性的标准例子。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The appendix presents the equation in its canonical form.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：名词常用 a cascade of；动词常用 cascade through；须说明传递路径，不能凭“连锁”一词暗示已验证的因果链。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A local disruption can cascade through an interconnected supply network.

scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal interpretation requires assumptions that are stronger than those needed to describe an association.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：causal 与 casual 拼写、含义不同。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal relationship cannot be inferred from prediction accuracy alone.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：不能仅因变量相关就命名为因果证据。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A causal study requires attention to alternative explanations.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：通常不可数；correlation 指统计关联，causality 关乎干预或机制下的因果主张；Granger causality 有特定预测含义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Predictive accuracy alone cannot establish causality.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：in chronological order；chronological age 指实际年龄；不能仅按随机序号排列就称 chronological。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The records are arranged in chronological order before the time-series analysis.
